definitions.explanation: Indicates that a package, order, or shipment has already been sent. Commonly seen in online shopping notifications, tracking pages, and business correspondence.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{発送済|はっそうず}みです。
examples.english: Your ordered item has been shipped.

examples.japanese: ⟦ステータス→ステータス：11585_suteetasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「{発送済|はっそうず}み」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。

{発送済|はっそうず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧⟦{二|ふつ}{日|か}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三|みっ}{日|か}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Shipped packages typically arrive within two to three days.

notes:
FORMS:
Formed from ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧ (shipping, dispatch) + ⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ (completed, done). The suffix ～⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ attaches to action nouns to indicate the action has been completed.

RELATED WORDS:
- {配達済|はいたつず}み (delivered)
- ⟦{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み→支払い済み：30038_shiharaizumi⟧ (paid)
- {確認済|かくにんず}み (confirmed)
- ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ (processed)

USAGE:
Often appears on tracking pages, email notifications, and order status screens. Can function as a noun or a pre-noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.
